endorsements.name: Mak Foss
endorsements.label: A beyond SIEMple way to develop detection analytics
endorsements.description: The rules that come out of the box for SIEMS and other security solutions are fine; they’ll catch some evil, but they’ll also generate a high volume of false positives. Luckily, there’s a ton of freely available resources—ranging from blogs and tweets to conference talks and videos—containing immense amounts of detailed information that detection engineers can use to develop detection capabilities. In this talk, we’ll use Red Canary’s 2022 Threat Detection Report and other freely available resources as inspiration to improve defense in depth by creating better detection analytics and SIEM-based alerting. Attendees will leave this talk with: – Actionable ideas that they can apply immediately to their detection engineering program – The ability to take content from information security research articles and adapt it into functional security controls – A better understanding of common adversary tradecraft
